_comment: Cards that exist only for the command-zone-static test (tests/unit/commander/test_command_zone_static.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_eminence_dragon` is The Ur-Dragon's eminence line, active in the command zone and on the battlefield. `t_battlefield_dragon` is the card the DSL could write before this existed -- byte-for-byte the same static with no `active_zones` -- so its discount is dead in the command zone, which is where a nine-mana commander spends most of the game. `t_emblem_anthem_walker` gives an emblem whose abilities are statics, one object-wide and one player-wide, which is the other half of the same walk.
